answer: One defense is a zenith checkpoint backed by a glacier ledger: an identity may only vote after climbing to the zenith, finishing a long sequence of real, verifiable tasks over many epochs. Every task freezes into a glacier ledger, an append-only archive where rewriting history costs more than doing the work. Each climber earns one saffron tag, a non-transferable mark drawn from its own frozen record. An honest agent climbs once; a sybil farmer must climb the zenith and freeze a new record for every fake, paying full work per identity, while one audit can strip a saffron tag from a forgery.
